title: Beauty Brand Manager
description:
Are you ready to take your career to the next level with a premium beauty brand portfolio? This is a rare opportunity to join a fast-paced, high-growth luxury beauty business where creativity, innovation, and commercial impact come together.

We are looking for a dynamic Brand Manager to shape and elevate brand presence across key retail channels, delivering best-in-class campaigns that inspire customers and drive performance.

Client Details

Our client is a leading player in the luxury beauty space, partnering with some of the world's most exciting premium brands to bring them to life in the UK market.

Working at the heart of the industry, they combine distribution expertise with creative marketing and retail execution, ensuring their brands stand out across top-tier retail environments.

Fast-paced, entrepreneurial and brand-led, this is a business where innovation, relationships and commercial impact truly matter.

Description

In this role, you will bring brands to life within the retail environment and ensure a seamless customer journey across all touchpoints.

You will:
- Lead the development and execution of innovative trade and shopper marketing strategies
- Create impactful campaigns and activations that reflect the luxury positioning of the brand
- Analyse market trends, consumer behaviour and competitor activity to unlock growth opportunities
- Partner cross-functionally with sales, brand and external agencies to ensure flawless execution
- Manage budgets effectively, delivering strong ROI
- Monitor and optimise performance through key KPIs

Profile

We are seeking a commercially driven, creative marketer who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

You will bring:
- Experience within beauty/FMCG, ideally with exposure to luxury brands
- Strong trade or shopper marketing expertise
- A deep understanding of consumer behaviour and retail dynamics
- Exceptional project and stakeholder management skills
- A proactive, solutions-focused mindset with a passion for excellence

Job Offer

What's in it for you?
- Competitive salary and benefits package
- Flexible working with a collaborative, supportive culture
- 3-4 days per week in a stunning Surrey office with a premium, inspiring working environment
- The opportunity to work with a leading luxury beauty portfolio
- High-impact role with real ownership and visibility across the business

This is a brilliant opportunity for a Brand Manager to combine career progression with a genuinely enjoyable place to work.

- Familiarity with website CMS platforms

- Familiarity with PPC and digital advertising

- Strong Excel skills

Experience with HubSpot, Looker Studio, property portals or similar tools would be particularly useful.

Previous experience within housebuilding, property, real estate or another consumer sector with a considered customer journey would be an advantage, but isn't essential.

Key responsibilities include:
- Developing and executing integrated digital marketing plans to drive brand awareness and sales growth.
- Managing paid and organic digital channels including social media, search, CRM and influencer marketing.
- Planning and delivering product launches, brand campaigns and promotional activities across digital touchpoints.
- Monitoring campaign effectiveness, reporting on KPIs and identifying opportunities for optimisation.
- Supporting website and digital platform development to improve user experience and conversion.
- Building strong relationships with agency partners, retailers and brand stakeholders.
- Managing marketing budgets and ensuring effective return on investment.
- Keeping up to date with emerging digital trends, technologies and consumer behaviours.
- Contributing to the development of the broader marketing strategy and mentoring junior team members where required.

Profile

- Proven experience in a Digital Marketing Manager role within FMCG, consumer goods or a related sector.
- Strong understanding of digital acquisition, CRM and social media.
- Experience managing multiple brands, projects and stakeholders simultaneously.
- Commercially minded with strong analytical and reporting skills.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills.
- A proactive, solutions-focused approach and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
- Experience working with major UK retailers would be advantageous.

Job Offer
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Hybrid working model with flexibility.
- Opportunity to work across a portfolio of well-known consumer brands.
- Collaborative and supportive culture.
- Genuine scope for career development and progression.

title: Senior Communications & Marketing Officer
description:
Summary

Are you a creative storyteller? Do you like creating inspiring content across a range of platforms using different media? If so, we're looking for a Senior Communications and Marketing Officer to plan and lead our communications and marketing for Munstead Wood. This is an exciting time to join a new National Trust project, with the opportunity to shape and develop the storytelling for this special place from the very beginning.

Salary: £17,620.20 per annum pro rated (£29,367 FTE)

Contract Duration: Fixed term until 31st October 2028

Working Pattern: You will work 22.5 hours per week, with a flexible working pattern. Your hours may vary depending on operational requirements, but evening/weekend work will be rare. Where this is required, time off in lieu will be provided.

Interviews will be held on Monday 26th October at Munstead Wood

If you have any queries or would like to learn more about this role please email: .uk What it's like to work here

Munstead Wood is an exciting recent acquisition for the National Trust. The personal home of garden designer and prolific content creator Gertrude Jekyll, it was designed in collaboration with Edwin Lutyens.

Based at the property in Godalming, you'll be part of a small on-property team looking after the day-to-day needs and running of the property, which is not currently open to the public. There is also an active project team working through the design and planning phase, developing detailed proposals and fundraising to support this work. As part of the on-property team, you'll develop and support communications around this exciting and evolving project. You will need to be able to work regularly on-site.

What you'll be doing

You'll create a dynamic communications plan for this evolving project, leading the development and delivery of original content to support its key messages and themes across a range of communication channels. You'll bring fresh, creative ideas to life, telling the stories of this inspirational place of creativity in ways that connect with audiences around the world.

This is a dynamic and collaborative role, working with stakeholders from across the organisation and externally. You'll bring together diverse expertise to create high-quality content across multiple strands of activity, ensuring work is delivered efficiently and to a consistently high standard.

Who we're looking for

We'd love to hear from you if you have:
- experience creating captivating content using different media across all platforms, and for a range of audiences
- the ability to work collaboratively and flexibly, both independently and as part of a team
- experience building relationships and working with internal and external stakeholders
- experience building dynamic communications plans for evolving projects
- strong proof-reading skills

The package

The National Trust has the motto 'For everyone, for ever' at its heart. We're working hard to create an inclusive culture, where everyone feels they belong. It's important that our people reflect and represent the diversity of the communities and audiences we serve. We welcome and value difference, so when we say we're for everyone, we want everyone to be welcome in our teams too.
- Substantial pension scheme of up to 10% basic salary
- Free entry to National Trust places for you, a guest and your children (under 18)
- Rental deposit loan scheme
- Season ticket loan
- EV car lease scheme (for roles that meet the salary criteria)
- Perks at work discounts such as gym memberships, shopping discount codes, cinema discounts
- Holiday allowance up to 32 days relating to length of service, plus holiday purchase scheme, subject to meeting minimum criteria.
- Flexible working whenever possible
- Employee assistance programme
- Free parking at most Trust places

Click here to find out more about the benefits we offer to support you.

title: Senior Digital Marketing Executive - Integrated Marketing Agency
description:
SEO Content Paid Media Email Social AI Search Client Strategy

Ready to Own More, Influence More and Grow With an Agency?

You've built solid experience in digital marketing. You know how campaigns come together, you're comfortable working with clients, and you're ready for a role where you can take greater ownership rather than simply execute someone else's plan.

Perhaps you're also looking for somewhere you can properly invest yourself. A close-knit agency where you'll be trusted, challenged and given the opportunity to grow as the business grows.

We're an established, award-winning integrated marketing agency entering an exciting new phase of growth, and we're looking for an experienced Senior Digital Marketing Executive to join our team.

This is an opportunity for a capable, proactive marketer who enjoys rolling up their sleeves, taking responsibility and delivering great work across a varied client portfolio.

The Role at a Glance

Senior Digital Marketing Executive
£35,000 - £40,000 DOE
Plus Benefits & Career Progression
Surrey Hybrid - 3 Days Office / 2 Days Home

Full-Time Permanent
Monday-Friday 8.30am-5.00pm

Who We Are

Red Ant is an established integrated marketing agency with more than 20 years' experience delivering high-quality B2 B and B2 C marketing communications across a diverse range of sectors.

Our experienced team specialises in website design and development, branding, digital marketing and creative communications, helping organisations strengthen their brands, improve their digital presence and achieve their business objectives.

We're now entering an exciting new phase of growth and looking for someone who wants to play a meaningful role in what comes next.

We're close-knit, professional and collaborative. We value long-term client relationships and believe the same longevity within our team creates a stronger, more settled business.

Working closely with the Digital Marketing Manager, you'll take ownership of digital campaigns across a diverse client portfolio, helping to plan, deliver and optimise activity across multiple channels.

You'll combine strategy, creativity and analysis, using campaign performance and insight to identify opportunities and continually improve results.

You'll also contribute to the agency's own marketing and market presence, bringing ideas and helping strengthen how we communicate and grow.

As a close-knit agency, people have visibility and influence here. We're looking for someone who takes responsibility, contributes ideas, follows things through and is happy to get stuck in when needed.

What You'll Bring

- Strong knowledge of content marketing, SEO, AI search, paid media, email marketing and social media.

Who Will Thrive Here?

This role will suit someone who has built strong foundations in digital marketing and is now looking for somewhere they can develop, take greater ownership and build the next stage of their career.

You'll enjoy being part of a smaller agency where people are trusted to deliver, contribute beyond a narrow job description and support one another when things get busy.

We're looking for someone dependable, motivated and comfortable with responsibility, but also ambitious enough to want to keep learning and take on more as the agency grows.

If you're looking for a role you can genuinely make your own and grow with over time, you'll fit in well here.

What We Offer

- The opportunity to make a genuine impact within a growing agency.

If you've built strong digital marketing experience and you're looking for a role where you can take ownership, contribute properly and grow with an established agency, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and take the next step in your digital marketing career.

title: Social Media and Marketing Executive
description:
About April Quest

April Quest specialises in permanent, contract and executive recruitment across engineering, science and technology. We connect talented people with ambitious businesses and take pride in the relationships we build with our clients, candidates and colleagues.

We re looking for a creative, proactive Social Media and Marketing Executive to help raise our profile, showcase our expertise and bring our company culture to life.

This opportunity would suit a marketing graduate or someone early in their career who enjoys creating content, has plenty of ideas and wants to see their work make a direct impact.

The Role

Working closely with our Managing Director, you ll help develop and deliver a practical social media and marketing strategy that supports attracting new clients and candidates who need specialist recruitment support and talented people to join the April Quest team.

LinkedIn will be your primary focus across all three audiences. You ll also develop our presence on Instagram and Facebook, particularly to showcase life at April Quest and support recruitment into our own business.

We want someone who spots opportunities, suggests fresh ideas and follows them through. You ll have support and direction from the Managing Director, alongside the opportunity to take ownership of day-to-day activity.

Key Responsibilities
- Work with the Managing Director to develop our social media and marketing strategy, agree priorities and turn ideas into achievable campaigns.
- Create and manage a content calendar, balancing industry insights, recruitment expertise, opportunities and company culture.
- Research our audiences, competitors and relevant trends, suggesting new ways to reach and engage the right people.
- Social media and content creation
- Manage our company LinkedIn, Instagram and Facebook accounts, tailoring content to each platform and audience.
- Create engaging posts, graphics, photographs and short videos that reflect April Quest s personality and expertise.
- Develop content around the industries we recruit within, including technology developments, hiring challenges, career advice and market insights.
- Turn the team s knowledge and experience into useful content, such as consultant interviews, practical advice and success stories.
- Monitor comments and messages, respond appropriately and direct enquiries to the relevant colleague.
- Capture photographs and videos at team socials, celebrations and company activities.
- Showcase what it s like to work at April Quest through employee stories, behind-the-scenes content and recruitment campaigns.
- Encourage colleagues to contribute ideas, appear in content and participate in social media activity.
- Help the team share relevant company content and strengthen their professional presence on LinkedIn.
- Support website content, blogs, email campaigns and marketing materials where relevant.
- Maintain a consistent tone of voice and visual style across our content.
- Track performance and share straightforward updates on what is working and what could improve.
- Assess success through relevant engagement, client and candidate enquiries, and interest in joining April Quest.
- Handle photographs, testimonials and client or candidate information with appropriate permission and care.

About You

You ll bring:
- Strong writing skills, attention to detail and an ability to adapt your message for different audiences.
- Familiarity with social media and networking platforms
- Creativity and an interest in photography, video and digital content.
- The confidence to suggest ideas, involve colleagues and get things moving.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage a varied workload.
- Curiosity about engineering, science, technology and the people working in these industries.
- A willingness to learn, test ideas and use feedback to improve.
- A degree in marketing, communications or a related subject would be welcome, but isn t essential. We re equally interested in relevant practical experience.
- Experience with tools such as Canva, video editing software or social media scheduling platforms would be useful. Previous recruitment industry experience is not required.

How To Apply

Please send your CV and a short introduction explaining why this role interests you. If you have examples of social media posts, videos, designs or marketing projects you ve created, we d love to see them.
